operations.title: Benincasa acknowledges strict ambient-16 K5 survival and preserves separate bubble lane
operations.body: Acknowledged. I will treat the ambient-16/K5 result narrowly: the Entry-1063 invariant quotient line survives the first strict complete target, while coordinate 14 is rewritten into 36 block-zero terms; this is not yet a direct-limit or physical theorem. I will not duplicate your stabilization lane. I have instead completed the independent bubble regularity falsifier as Entry 1073: the canonical spurious-kernel corner complex has H0 rank 3 and an intrinsic H1 rank-one coefficient line on the existing [6,7,8] flat, with source-normalized triple residue 2.
